PcosSkinHair.6: PCOS izmer ad d-yawi isnifilen yettwaẓran deg uglim, deg uɛecwiw n ugarsiw neɣ deg uceggiɛ n uqerruy. Ma tfehmeḍ ansi d-ttalin, yelha ad ten-tesneḍ u ad teẓreḍ acu n tifrat i izmer ad tettwafkar.
PcosSkinHair.7: Tilɣa-a tella s waṭas, maca weḥd-sent ur d-ttarrant ara ayen ilaqen neɣ ayen yeksen i usenqed n PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.15: Acu i izmer ad k-iɛiwen yal ass
PcosSkinHair.19: PCOS izmer ad d-yawi taseddi neɣ armad ugar n yiandrojenen, hurmunen i yellan daɣen d ayla n tilawin. Mi ara yili wanect-a d ameqqran, izmer ad yesâddi ɣef tgilit n yir-ujeddig, ɣef iẓuran n uceɛɛar d ddawra n uzgen n uceɛɛar.
PcosSkinHair.20: Aḥraf-a n yihurmunen d ayen i izmer ad d-yesseklen acuɣer ttbanen lḥebb ittuɣalen, aseggem n uceɛɛar neɣ, ɣer kra n tilawin, tameẓẓuɣt n uceɛɛar.
PcosSkinHair.22: Tilɣa yettwaẓran ur d-ttbeggint ara yal tikkelt acḥal i yeqqwa PCOS. Yal tameṭṭut tezmer ad tesɛu aṭas n tilɣa yettwaẓran, tayeḍ tezmer ad tesɛu kra kan neɣ ula d yiwet.
PcosSkinHair.23: Lḥebb i d-yeqqnen ɣer yisnifilen n yihurmunen izmer ad d-yeban neɣ ad yeqqim ɣer tama n tegrawla. Ittnaɣ ad yaweḍ ɣer tkerrust, ɣer tama n wanzaren, ɣer yidmawen n ddaw neɣ kra n tikkelt ɣer tgecrirt.
PcosSkinHair.24: Ɣer kra n yimdanen, lḥebb-a yedder deg ukessar, yettwaḍheq u yettuɣal. Izmer daɣen ad yeǧǧ azegzaw neɣ iḥricen mi ara ttwaqqen neɣ mi ara yili yettwaḥmi aṭas.
PcosSkinHair.25: Tilɣa i izmer ad tbanen deg uglim
PcosSkinHair.26: Lḥebb ittuɣalen, nezzeh deg uda n ddaw n udmawen
PcosSkinHair.28: Tuɣalin n lḥebb i yettaḍfaren kra n tikkal isnifilen n yihurmunen
PcosSkinHair.29: Izegzawen neɣ iḥricen i d-yeqqimen seld tuɣalin n lḥebb
PcosSkinHair.30: Hirsutisme yeqqen ɣer useggem n uceɛɛar aqehwan deg tamnaḍin ur nettwaɣ ara s waṭas ɣer tilawin. Deg wanda yella PCOS, izmer ad yeqqen ɣer tikli n yiandrojenen ɣef iẓuran n uceɛɛar.
PcosSkinHair.31: Tamnaḍin i yettwaḥsen s waṭas d tgecrirt, tuṣiwt n ufus n ufella, aẓar, aɣerrus neɣ aḍar. Acḥal n uceɛɛar i d-yettilin yemxalaf aṭas seg yiwen ɣer wayeḍ.
PcosSkinHair.34: Uceɛɛar yeqqwan ugar ɣef tgecrirt neɣ ɣef ufus n ufella
PcosSkinHair.35: Uceɛɛar i izmer ad d-yeffeɣ ɣef uẓar, aɣerrus neɣ aḍar
PcosSkinHair.36: Tameẓẓuɣt s wudem ɣezzifen n uceɛɛar ɣef ukerruy n uqerruy
PcosSkinHair.38: Useggem n uceɛɛar yettγaḍ daɣen ɣer yisnifilen n tgensa d wid n yal yiwen. Ma yella uceɛɛar yettwaẓran aṭas, ur yeqqen ara s wudem awurman ɣer PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.39: Kra n tilawin ɣer-sent PCOS ttwaliḥ-d daɣen tamẓẓuɣt n uceɛɛar. Tameẓẓuɣt tezmer ad tbeggen s wudem ugar ɣef ukerruy n uqerruy neɣ ɣef tgecrirt n uceɛɛar.
PcosSkinHair.40: Waya izmer ad yeḍru s wudem aqrawan. Yelha ad tfarqeḍ gar tuccḍa n uceɛɛar i yeqqnen ɣer yihurmunen d ssebbat-nniḍen, am uḥewwes, ugur n ṭṭiroid, kra n yimessilen neɣ tallalt n ṭṭeḥmil ameqqran.
PcosSkinHair.42: Tuccḍa n uceɛɛar ameqqran, taẓirant neɣ ur nelli ara d tin n yal ass teḥwağ asenqed n uṭṭbib i wakken ad tt-id-nafeḍ ssebba.
PcosSkinHair.43: Agbur yennerni, yelhan, yezmer ad yili yelha ugar n usemres n waṭas n yimsalen. Axxam ad teslekkeḍ, ad tessirdeḍ u ad tḥerseḍ aglim mi ara tessefkeḍ ur d-yettusebb ara ttwaḥmi.
PcosSkinHair.44: Agbur n uglim yelhan, yettuɣalen s lemɛawda
PcosSkinHair.48: Mi ara yili uceɛɛar ifzzen ugar, yezmer ad yelhu ma tekkseḍ sdat-s aṭṭas n tegrawla: ugar n tezmert n tmes, imawlan yeqqen aṭas neɣ iselkimen kimyawiyen i d-yettuɣalen s waṭas.
PcosSkinHair.49: Asinag ɣer uṭṭbib n uglim yezmer ad yili yelha ma yella tameẓẓuɣt n uceɛɛar tkemmel, i wakken ad d-tettwafk ssebba u ad tettwamsawal ɣef yiɣbalen i yellan.
PcosSkinHair.51: Fren iɣbalen yelhan u ur tessemlalaḍ ara aṭas n yiɣbalen n wuṣṣuf
PcosSkinHair.52: Sired aglim war ma tessnefsled-it, deg uṣebḥi d tameddit ma yella lazem
PcosSkinHair.53: Seqdec ammesrar n yiṭij mi ara yili uglim yeẓran
PcosSkinHair.54: Ur tḥekkuḍ ara deg iḥricen i wakken ad tessenqseḍ izegzawen d iḥricen
PcosSkinHair.55: Nadi leqdic n umaẓrag ma yella tilɣa tkemmel neɣ tettuɣal d tameqqrant
PcosSkinHair.56: Aɣbel yettkel ɣef tilɣa, ɣef tezmert-nsent, ɣef yir-yiman ɣef tudert d ɣef iswi n yal tameṭṭut. Yezmer ad yelhu ad temlil ɣef aṭas n yiɣal deg wanda ad tnadiḍ yiwen n tifrat kan.
PcosSkinHair.58: Agbur yelhan d lqerḥ n uṭṭbib n uglim ma yella lazem.
PcosSkinHair.60: Tifrat n uzzuzer neɣ n ṭṭbib ɣef wass i d-tuɣal temsalt.
PcosSkinHair.62: Af-d ssebba send ad tferneḍ aɣbel.
PcosSkinHair.64: Ṭṭef deg uṭṭbib acu i d-yeqqim deg wul n tilɣa.
PcosSkinHair.65: Yelha ad temmeslayeḍ d umaẓrag n tezmert ma yella lḥebb yettuɣal d ameqqran neɣ d ameccuq, ma yella uceɛɛar yettaseɣ s tazzla, ma yella uceɛɛar yeffeẓ ɣef waṭas neɣ ma yella ddawra n tiregwa mačči d tin n yal tikkelt.
PcosSkinHair.66: Aṭṭbib n uglim izmer ad yekkes tilɣa n uglim d uceɛɛar. Aṭṭbib n tilawin neɣ amaẓrag-nniḍen i yettwasnen izmer daɣen ad yessenqed taɣult n yihurmunen d tilɣa-nniḍen i izmer ad tilint n PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.68: Useggem uṭṭun yettwaẓran, tameẓẓuɣt tuffɣa neɣ isnifilen n yihurmunen ur nelli ara d ayen n yal ass, yeḥwaǧ lqerḥ n uṭṭbib.
PcosSkinHair.69: Lḥebb ur yeqqim ara yeqqen s wudem awurman ɣer PCOS
PcosSkinHair.70: Uceɛɛar yettwaẓran ur yeqqen ara dayem ɣer yihurmunen kan
PcosSkinHair.71: PCOS izmer ad yewwet tilawin n yal tamsit n ugmuḍ
PcosSkinHair.72: Tilɣa zemrent ad ttbeddilent akken i ibedd lweqt u ur d-ttemcabint ara i yal tameṭṭut
PcosSkinHair.73: Tilɣa yettwaẓran n PCOS zemrent ad d-awint ccwal, maca ur d-ttbeggint ara tilawt-ik, azal-ik neɣ taneḍfa-inek.
PcosSkinHair.75: PCOS izmer ad yewwet aglim, uceɛɛar n ugris d uceɛɛar n uqerruy.
PcosSkinHair.76: Tilɣa ttemxalafent aṭas seg yiwet tmeṭṭut ɣer tayeḍ.
PcosSkinHair.77: Yiwet n tilɣa weḥdes ur tekfi ara i usenqed n PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.78: Llan tifrat i izmer ad tgellib tilɣa.
PcosSkinHair.79: Tallalt n uṭṭbib tezmer ad k-d-teǧǧ ad tferneḍ abrid i k-d-yelhan.
PcosSkinHair.81: Lḥebb, useggem n uceɛɛar neɣ tameẓẓuɣt n uceɛɛar zemrent ad ilint d tilɣa n PCOS, maca ur d-ttilint ara s wudem ilaqen. Abrid yettwasbedden i yiman-ik yezmer ad k-iɛiwen ad tɛasseḍ tilɣa yelhan ugar u ad tḥessed yiman-ik ulac ugur yal ass.
PcosSkinHair.82: Amagrad-a yella i lǧerr n talɣut kan, ur d-yettnaqqes ara asinag n uṭṭbib, asenqed neɣ aɣbel yettwasbedden i yiman-ik.
PcosSkinHair.83: Aglim, uceɛɛar d tilɣa yettwaẓran n PCOS — AWA

PerineumStrengthening.6: Seld lḥemla d tulawt, lpirine yesra lweqt i wakken ad d-yuɣal. Ineɣman yessefken, yellan s lemɛawda u s wudem aqrawan zemrent ad k-iɛiwen ad d-tafeḍ tazmert, aɛekkem d ttiqa, war ma tettaɛǧalt.
PerineumStrengthening.8: Ad tfehmeḍ ayen i ixeddem lpirine
PerineumStrengthening.10: Melmi ara tebdu tuɣalin n lpirine
PerineumStrengthening.11: Ad tessneḍ amek ara tessemmedeḍ akken iwata
PerineumStrengthening.12: Taggara n lbarnamaj s wudem aqrawan
PerineumStrengthening.15: Tuɣalin n uzeṭṭa s wudem aqrawan
PerineumStrengthening.18: Asenneɣ n lpirine seld tulawt — AWA
PerineumStrengthening.19: Ad tfehmeḍ ayen i ixeddem lpirine
PerineumStrengthening.20: Lpirine, i d-yettusemman daɣen aferdis n lbasin, d tagrumt n iferdasen yellan deg uda n lbasin. Yesɛa tamlilt deg uḥkem n tbuqit d uzgen n yimi n uẓar, u yettɛawan ad yeṭṭef iɣsan n lbasin.
PerineumStrengthening.21: Deg lḥemla, iferdasen-a ilaqen ad d-ḥmelen aggar ugar n wazal ɣef waṭas n wayyuren. Daɣen ttɛeddin ugur ameqqran deg tulawt.
PerineumStrengthening.22: Afferdis ur d-yettban ara maca ilaqen
PerineumStrengthening.23: Aferdis n lbasin yettekkild deg waṭas n yimala n yal ass: aḥbas n yiɣi d uẓelmaḍ, aḥkem deg ugaz, aɛawen n iɣsan n lbasin, u yesɛa tamlilt deg kra n yimala n tugniwin.
PerineumStrengthening.25: Asenneɣ s wudem aqrawan u s wudem ilaqen izmer ad yeɛiwen ad yelhu uḥkem d wawaɛun n lpirine.
PerineumStrengthening.28: Aferdis n lbasin yesɛa tamlilt deg uḥkem n tbuqit. Asenneɣ-is s wudem aqrawan izmer ad yessenqes kra n yimalen n iɣi.
PerineumStrengthening.31: Iferdasen-a ɛawnen daɣen deg uḥkem n ugaz d uẓelmaḍ, u ttekkin deg uɛawen n yiɣsan n lbasin.
PerineumStrengthening.34: Aferdis n lbasin d aseggas n yiferdasen i iɛawnen ad ṭṭfen tbuqit, tazmert d tamrart.
PerineumStrengthening.36: Tuɣalin n uḥulfu s wudem aqrawan
PerineumStrengthening.37: Uɣal-nni ilaqen izmer daɣen ad k-iɛiwen ad tḥessed akken iwata aḥkem n tmennaḍt-a.
PerineumStrengthening.38: Acuɣer lḥemla d tulawt ttɛeddi-ten aṭas
PerineumStrengthening.39: Lḥemla tesseḥmel s wudem aqrawan ugar n uẓeṭṭa ɣef uferdis n lbasin. Tulawt n tgecrirt tezmer ad tessaɣ iferdasen d yirawen n tmennaḍt-a aṭas.
PerineumStrengthening.40: Taɣuri n yimi n uqerruy (césarienne) daɣen ur tessekfa ara aferdis n lbasin akken ilaq: lḥemla s timmad-is tbeddu d aseggas ameqqran i yiferdasen-a.
PerineumStrengthening.41: Seld tulawt, d ayen amagnu ad tettwaḥtaǧ tuɣalin lweqt. Kra n tilawin ur ḥessent ara aṭas, wiyaḍ zemrent ad ẓrent iɣi, ahlil n ugari neɣ tsemmeḍt n uḥkem n yiferdasen.
PerineumStrengthening.43: Amanaw n tulawt, azegzaw neɣ episiotomie, tin i yellan n lweǧɛ, d waddad-ik amatu seld tulawt, ttɛeddin ɣef tuɣalin.
PerineumStrengthening.44: Melmi ara tebdu tuɣalin n uferdis n lbasin?
PerineumStrengthening.45: Seld tulawt war ugur, ameẓẓuɣt n uferdis n lbasin s wudem yelhan tezmer ad d-tuɣal s wudem aqrawan. Yelha ad tessewjdeḍ ineɣman i waddad-ik u ad tsuteḍ tallalt ma tɛeddiḍ ugur, lweǧɛ ameqqran neɣ ttuɣal n kra n wazal usligen.
PerineumStrengthening.46: Ma tesɛiḍ tabbut n ubeṭṭu (sonde), kra n yiwellihen ssumren ad txedmeḍ ayen-a ar ttwakkes u ar yuɣal ubeṭṭu amagnu send ad tebduḍ ineɣman n lpirine.
PerineumStrengthening.48: Lweǧɛ ameqqran, tilɣa i d-yettuɣalen d wayen yellan d aɣelnaw, aḥric ur nettwali ara, neɣ yal kra i k-yeɛnan teḥwağ tallalt n taqabalt, n uṭṭbib neɣ n umaẓrag n tuɣalin.
PerineumStrengthening.49: Ad tessneḍ amek ara tessemmedeḍ akken iwata
PerineumStrengthening.50: I wakken ad tafeḍ ineɣman, sɛu tamuɣli ukud tettḥebseḍ ugaz d uzelmaḍ ɣer yiwen n lweqt. Ineɣman i tebɣiḍ d usemmed d usebbek ɣer daxel.
PerineumStrengthening.51: Iswi mačči d asemmed n ugris meṛṛa. Iɣafen, ifassen d uḍar ilaqen ad d-qqimen d izellilen kan, mi ara tkemmleḍ tuffɣa n usemmid amagnu.
PerineumStrengthening.61: Seld yal asemmed, eǧǧ iferdasen ad nfusen akk. Asenneɣ yelhan ur yeqqen ara ɣer usemmed n lpirine ass meṛṛa.
PerineumStrengthening.62: Taggara n lbarnamaj s wudem aqrawan
PerineumStrengthening.63: Deg tazwara, ayen yelhan s waṭas d ad tsenmeḍ iferdasen u ad txedmeḍ ineɣman akken iwata. Lemɛawda tezmer ugar n tezmert.
PerineumStrengthening.65: Semmed aferdis n lbasin s wudem ahlawan, sakin ṭṭef asemmed kra n tasinin war ma tessaṭeḍ asemmid. Sakin eǧǧ-it akk send ad tebduḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.
PerineumStrengthening.67: Mi ara tesɛu ineɣman, tzemreḍ ad ternuḍ isemmeden imecṭuḥen uzzigen. Ttɛawanen ad tsenseḍ tazmert n usemmed uzzig mi ara tettaru uzɣal deg ukerruy, am ṭṭerf send tuccḍa neɣ tatsut.
PerineumStrengthening.69: Qqen ineɣman d tamezzit n yal ass
PerineumStrengthening.75: Err azal i tallalt n unfusel
PerineumStrengthening.79: Suter tallalt ma yella ur tettḥeqqeḍ ara
PerineumStrengthening.81: Aqqen n yineɣman ɣer tamezzit i yellan yakan deg wass-ik zemren ad k-ɛawnen ad tkemmleḍ: seld unnaw n uqabaɣ, seld usired n tuɣmas, neɣ deg wakud-nniḍen i k-yelhan.
PerineumStrengthening.83: Ineɣman n lpirine zemren ad banen d imecṭuḥ, maca d ayen yewɛer ad tessemreḍ iferdasen-nniḍen neɣ ad tessaṭeḍ aṭas.
PerineumStrengthening.84: Asemmed n yiɣafen neɣ n uḍar deg ubdil n uferdis n lbasin
PerineumStrengthening.86: Aṭṭaf n iferdasen yesmeddan dima war ma tefsiḍ-iten
PerineumStrengthening.87: Aḍfar n yineɣman kra n wussan kan sakin tḥebseḍ
PerineumStrengthening.88: Aḥbas n wumjer n iɣi s wudem uslig i wakken ad tneqqeḍ asemmed
PerineumStrengthening.90: Ur yettusumer ara ad txedmeḍ ineɣman s uḥbas n wumjer n iɣi s wudem uslig. Tarrayt-a ur tesseggem ara lpirine akken iwata u tezmer ad tessenfeli tamahut tamagnut n tbuqit.
PerineumStrengthening.91: Acu n tilɣa ilaqen ad k-yawin ɣer usinag?
PerineumStrengthening.92: Iɣi imecṭuḥen neɣ uḥulfu ur nelli ara d amagnu zemren ad d-banen seld tulawt. Maca ur ilaq ara ad ten-tuklalḍ ma ttkemmilen, ma ttuɣalen yir neɣ ma ttɛeṭṭilen tudert-ik n yal ass.
PerineumStrengthening.93: Iɣi n iɣi mi ara tetsedmeḍ, tessmeslayeḍ, tmeṭṭeḍ neɣ mi ara tettaɛǧalt
PerineumStrengthening.94: Uḥulfu n uẓeṭṭa neɣ n uggar deg ukerruy n lbasin
PerineumStrengthening.95: Uḥulfu n wayen ibedden neɣ n kra i d-yettuɣalen ɣer uqqerruy n tgella
PerineumStrengthening.96: Tuccḍa n uṭṭaf n ugaz neɣ n uẓelmaḍ
PerineumStrengthening.98: Lweǧɛ deg neɣ seld tuddsa n tugniwin
PerineumStrengthening.99: Tuccḍa n usnen neɣ n usemmed akken iwata n yiferdasen n lpirine
PerineumStrengthening.101: Taqabalt, aṭṭbib neɣ amaẓrag n tuɣalin yettwasnen deg uferdis n lbasin zemren ad ssenqden tazmert n yiferdasen u ad d-sumren barnamaj yelhan.
PerineumStrengthening.102: D acu seld uzegzaw, episiotomie neɣ taɣuri n yimi n uqerruy (césarienne)?
PerineumStrengthening.103: Azegzaw neɣ episiotomie ttḥewwiṣen aɣbel ixusen deg lweqt n usseɣ. Ttuɣalin n yimala ilaqen ad ttwakkan deg uḥsab lweǧɛ, waddad n uḥricen d iwellihen i d-yettwafken seld tulawt.
PerineumStrengthening.104: Seld césarienne, tuɣalin teqqen daɣen ɣer uglim n uqerruy d uḥricen. Ula ma yella ur tella ara tulawt s uẓar, lḥemla timmad-is tessaɣ aferdis n lbasin.
PerineumStrengthening.106: Ma yella uzegzaw ameqqran, lweǧɛ, tilɣa n iɣi neɣ n yiɣsan, neɣ uɣilif ittkemmilen, asenqed d umaẓrag n ṣṣeḥḥa yezmer ad yili yelha aṭas.
PerineumStrengthening.107: Tuɣalin n uzeṭṭa s wudem aqrawan
PerineumStrengthening.108: Tuɣalin n tikli seld tulawt ilaq ad tili s wudem aqrawan. Tikli d yisnifilen ahlawan zemren ad uɣalen akken ad tḥessed, maca imala iweɛren s waṭas ttuḥwağen ugar n uḥseb.
PerineumStrengthening.109: Send ad terrḍed tazzla, aɣli neɣ asemmid yeqwan aṭas, yelha ad tesnezreḍ tuɣalin n uferdis n lbasin u ad tettwafkeḍ tilɣa deg uḥsab.
PerineumStrengthening.111: Iɣi, uḥulfu n uẓeṭṭa neɣ lweǧɛ deg neɣ seld uzeṭṭa d tilɣa i d-yeqqen ad tessenqeseḍ s wudem wezzil u ad tsuteḍ tallalt send ad tessnernud tazmert.
PerineumStrengthening.113: Tuɣalin n uferdis n lbasin ɣer taqabalt neɣ amaẓrag n tuɣalin tezmer ad tili tlelha ma yella ur tessineḍ ara ma tessemmedeḍ akken iwata, ma ttkemmilent tilɣa neɣ ma tebɣiḍ ad tuɣaleḍ ɣer kra n yimala n tgensa s wuklal.
PerineumStrengthening.115: Tilɣa-iw ttemcabint ɣer tmerẓeq n uferdis n lbasin?
PerineumStrengthening.117: Acḥal n tikkal ilaqen ad xedmeɣ yal ass?
PerineumStrengthening.118: Zemreɣ ad uɣaleɣ ɣer tazzla, ɣer tgensa neɣ ɣer ineɣman iweɛren?
PerineumStrengthening.119: Ilaq-iyi unnaw n tuɣalin ɣer taqabalt neɣ amaẓrag n tuɣalin?
PerineumStrengthening.120: Azegzaw-iw, tazzla-iw neɣ césarienne-iw ttuḥwağen kra n lḥedd?
PerineumStrengthening.122: Aẓer n umaẓrag ur yeqqen ara dima ɣer ugur. Asnez yezmer ad k-iɛiwen ad tessenqedeḍ tarrayt-ik, ad tesḥseḍ tuɣalin-ik u ad tessneḍ amek ara tgeddeḍ.
PerineumStrengthening.124: Seld ma tulaḍ, d ayen amagnu ur tuɣaleḍ ara ɣer yiḥulfawen neɣ ɣer tezmert n yiferdasen i tesɛiḍ send lḥemla, deg yiwen n lweqt.
PerineumStrengthening.125: Iswi mačči d ad txedmeḍ aṭas n yisemmeden. D ayen ugar n tuɣalin n tarrayt yelhan gar usemmed d unfusel, sakin ad tessemreḍ iferdasen-a s wudem amagnu deg yimala n yal ass.
PerineumStrengthening.126: Ssenfar imecṭuḥen d ssenfar n tidet
PerineumStrengthening.127: Ahulfu ahlawan n usemmid, kra n tasinin d-yernan deg usemmed, neɣ aneqqes n iɣi, d tilɣa yettɛawanen yakan.
PerineumStrengthening.130: Lḥemla d tulawt ttɛeddi-ten aṭas iferdasen n lbasin.
PerineumStrengthening.131: Tuɣalin s wudem aqrawan d ayen amagnu seld tulawt.
PerineumStrengthening.132: Ineɣman ilaqen ad d-ssinfen lǧuda n usemmid uqbel tazmert.
PerineumStrengthening.133: Anfas d unfusel ɛzizen am usemmed.
PerineumStrengthening.134: Iɣi n iɣi, uḥulfu n uẓeṭṭa neɣ lweǧɛ ittkemmilen ilaq-asen rray n umaẓrag.
PerineumStrengthening.135: Tuɣalin ɣer taqabalt neɣ amaẓrag n tuɣalin tezmer ad k-tɛiwen ad d-tafeḍ aḥkem ugar.
PerineumStrengthening.136: Tuɣalin ɣer tgensa ilaq ad tili s wudem aqrawan, nezzeh imala iweɛren.
PerineumStrengthening.137: Eǧǧ lweqt i wakken ad d-tuɣaleḍ
PerineumStrengthening.138: Seld tulawt, ayen i ixeddem ugris-ik yettɛeddi aṭas n yisnifilen. Lpirine yessefk ad yeṭṭef ccan am wayen-nniḍen n ugris-ik: s wudem aqrawan, s lemɛawda u war aẓeṭṭa.
PerineumStrengthening.139: Amagrad-a yella i lǧerr n talɣut kan u ur d-yettnaqqes ara talwit n uṭṭbib i yiman-ik. Ma tḥessed lweǧɛ, tilɣa ittkemmilen neɣ ma tesɛiḍ tuṭṭfa ɣef tuɣalin-ik, suter talwit i umaẓrag n ṣṣeḥḥa.

PeriodPain.6: Timmi, iseḥḥen ahlawan, tuččit: iɣal i d-yettawin tifrat s tidet.
PeriodPain.12: Uḥulfu n lweǧɛ yekka-d seg usemmed n tkerrust i ɛawnen ad d-teffeɣ tgecrirt n tkerrust. Prostaglandines d ssebba-s. Yal ugris ixeddem s wudem-is.
PeriodPain.14: Lweǧɛ yezmer ad yemxalef seg yiwen n uzray ɣer wayeḍ u ur yelli ara d amcabi dima.
PeriodPain.16: Tazbart n waman iẓẓayen ɣef uda n ddaw n uɣerrus tezmer ad tesfeḍ iferdasen.
PeriodPain.18: Yoga, aseḍḍi d tikli tafessast sfeḍment aɣilif.
PeriodPain.20: Magnésium, omega-3 d wayen i yekkesen taɣbalut.
PeriodPain.22: Asew n waman yemkulen yettɛawan ad yeqqes uḥulfu n uẓeṭṭa.
PeriodPain.24: Asnimlal aṭuṭṭu ɣef uda n ddaw n uɣerrus yettɛawan ad tsenfseleḍ.
PeriodPain.25: Ma yella lweǧɛ ur k-yeǧǧa ara ad tettidireḍ s wudem amagnu yal aggur ɣas ma tesseqdceḍ tifrat-a, yelha ad temmeslayeḍ d umaẓrag n ṣṣeḥḥa.
PeriodPain.27: Lweǧɛ yeqwan aṭas, aḥraf ameqqran n idammen, ɣeṛ-i leɛyaṭ ameqqran neɣ tilɣa ur nelli ara d tiɣelnawin.
PeriodPain.28: Sidid ugris-ik s wudem ahlawan mi ara tkecmeḍ
PeriodPain.30: Eǧǧ lweqt i wanfas d unfusel
PeriodPain.31: Ḍfer ddawra-inek i wakken ad tfehmeḍ ugar lweǧɛ-ik
PeriodPain.32: Aɣbel n lweǧɛ n tiregwa — AWA

Pms.1:
Aɣilif send tiregwa (PMS):
ad t-nefhem yelhan ugar
Pms.4: PMS yettaɣ ɣer 8 seg 10 n tilawin ar tazwara. Leɛyaṭ, tuɣalin n uẓar, uḥulfu n uẓeṭṭa… Ad tfehmeḍ ssebbat-is u ad tsemreḍ iɣal yelhan zemren ad d-awin ameẓẓuy ameqqran i wakud-a n useggas.
Pms.9: Iwellihen i wakken ad tḥessed yelhan ugar
Pms.11: Aɣilif send tiregwa yesdukkel tilɣa tigarasanin d tilɣa n wul i d-yettbanen s wudem amagnu 5 ɣer 10 n wussan send tiregwa-ik u ttwaksen deg tazwara n ddawra n tiregwa.
Pms.13: Tilɣa ttbanent send tiregwa-ik u ttnaqqasent s wudem amagnu mi ara tebdu.
Pms.15: Azal d wanaw n tilɣa zemren ad ttemxalafen aṭas seg yiwet tmeṭṭut ɣer tayeḍ, u seg yiwen n uzray ɣer wayeḍ.
Pms.17: Aɣilif, uṭṭun, tamɣart, isnifilen n wul
Pms.19: Uḥulfu n uẓeṭṭa, lweǧɛ, leɛyaṭ, lweǧɛ n uqerruy
Pms.21: Ugar n usukkeṛ, isnifilen n ṭṭeɛm, leɛyaṭ
Pms.23: Ugur n unẓar neɣ anẓar ur nelli ara d aṛṛaḥ
Pms.24: Isnifilen n yihurmunen, nezzeh d wid n progestérone d estrogène, ttɛeddin ɣef yineṭṭiqen n uqerruy (sérotonine, dopamine), ayen izmer ad d-yesseklen tilɣa n wul d tilɣa n ugris n PMS.
Pms.26: Isnifilen n yihurmunen zemren ad ɛeṭṭlen ayen n wul, tazmert, anẓar d kra n yiḥulfawen n ugris.
Pms.28: Asew n waman yemkulen yettɛawan ad yeqqes uḥulfu n uẓeṭṭa.
Pms.30: Fren iwlilen id-yessewten magnésium, omega-3 d tivitamines B.
Pms.32: Tagnit n ugris tessuffeɣ endorphines u tessenqes aɣilif.
Pms.34: Ineɣman n unfas, anefsay, aɣmis… Af-d ayen i k-yelhan.
Pms.36: Anẓar yelhan yettɛawan deg umendad n yihurmunen.
Pms.37: Melmi ara tsuteḍ tallalt n uṭṭbib?
Pms.38: Ma yella tilɣa d tiqwayanin aṭas u ttɛeṭṭilent tudert-ik n yal ass, izmer ad yili d PMDD (ugur n wul send tiregwa). Ur tettaɛǧalt ara ad tmeslayeḍ d umaẓrag n ṣṣeḥḥa.
Pms.39: Aɣilif send tiregwa (PMS): ad t-nefhem yelhan ugar — AWA

PostpartumPeriodReturn.1:
Tuɣalin n tiregwa seld tulawt,
acu ara d-yeḍru
PostpartumPeriodReturn.4: Seld tulawt, tuɣalin n tiregwa tezmer ad tettwaḥtaǧ lweqt. Akud yemxalaf, nezzeh ɣef tmesmuṭ n uẓẓal, u yal yiwet tezmer ad tḥess wakud-a s wudem-is.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.5: Tuɣalin n tiregwa seld tulawt, acu ara d-yeḍru — AWA
PostpartumPeriodReturn.6: 1. D acu i d tuɣalin n tiregwa seld tulawt?
PostpartumPeriodReturn.7: “Tuɣalin n tiregwa” d mi ara d-tuɣal tiregwa-ik seld tulawt. Ddawra n tiregwa ur d-tettuɣal ara dima s wudem arurem ɣer ugmuḍ-is amagnu.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.9: Ulac akud yiwen i yellan i yal yiwen.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.11: Akud yettkel s waṭas ɣef uẓẓal. War uẓẓal, tiregwa-ik tezmer ad d-tuɣal s wudem amatu zdat 6 ɣer 8 n yimalas. S uẓẓal usligen, tezmer ad tettwaɛeṭṭel kra n wayyuren.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.13: S wudem amatu zdat 6 ɣer 8 n yimalas.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.15: Tuɣalin tezmer ad tettwaɛeṭṭel kra n wayyuren.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.17: Ddawra d-tettuɣal s wudem aqrawan seld tulawt. Uẓẓal izmer ad yesâddi ɣef wakud n twalit n tiregwa-ik.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.18: Tuɣalin n ddawra s wudem aqrawan
PostpartumPeriodReturn.21: Ddawra n tiregwa tbedd s wudem uzɣel seld tulawt.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.23: Ugris yettuɣal s wudem aqrawan u ukud n yihurmunen yettbeddil.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.25: Uẓẓal izmer ad yɛeṭṭel tuɣalin n tiregwa, maca tazmert-is temxalaf seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.27: Tiregwa-ik tamezwarut tezmer ad d-tuɣal seld kra n yimalas neɣ kra n wayyuren.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.29: Ddurat zemrent ad ilint ur nelli ara d tiremmanin send ad ttuɣalent s wudem aqrawan ɣer ugmuḍ-nsent amagnu.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.30: Ulac akud yemcabin i yal yiwen. Tuɣalin n tiregwa tezmer ad temxalef seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ, nezzeh s ssebba n uẓẓal.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.32: Mi ara d-tuɣal tiregwa-ik, ddurat tizwura zemrent ad ttemxalafent d wid n send lḥemla. Nezzeh, zemrent ad ilint ur nelli ara d tiremmanin deg tazwara.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.34: Ddawra tezmer ad tettwaḥtaǧ lweqt i wakken ad d-tuɣal ɣer ugmuḍ i tessneḍ.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.36: Aḥraf izmer ad yemxalef ɣef wayen i tẓerreḍ send lḥemla.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.37: 5. D acu i izmer ad tẓerreḍ?
PostpartumPeriodReturn.38: Aḍfar afessas yettɛawan ad tẓerreḍ ugar amek tetteglu ddawra-inek akken ibedd lweqt.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.42: Ẓer s wudem aqrawan tallunt gar ddurat.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.44: Ẓer kan isnifilen ɣef wayen i d-yettwaɛedden i kečč.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.46: Ma yella kra yettban d ayen ur nelli ara d amagnu, ittkemmilen neɣ yettaɣ-ik, suter talwit n umaẓrag n ṣṣeḥḥa.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.47: Aḥraf n idammen i k-d-yettbanen d ayen ur nelli ara d amagnu
PostpartumPeriodReturn.52: Tuɣalin n tiregwa seld tulawt d mi ara d-tuɣal tiregwa-ik seld tulawt.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.53: Uẓẓal izmer ad yɛeṭṭel tuɣalin n tiregwa-ik.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.54: Ddurat tizwura zemrent ad ilint ur nelli ara d tiremmanin.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.55: Aɣmis n yussan yettɛawan ad tḍefreḍ amek tetteglu ddawra-inek.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.56: Agbur n talɣut. Aseggas n wakud izmer ad yemxalef ɣef yal waddad u ur d-yettnaqqes ara talwit n uṭṭbib.
